items.name: bl-ui
items.title: BL UI
items.description: BL UI's tokens and framework CSS: registers its extra color utilities (text-tertiary-foreground, bg-bar, text-success, …), the radius, text-size, shadow and size scales and the spring motion tokens next to shadcn's, plus the keyframes and scrollbar rules the parts use. Every other item depends on it.

items.docs: BL UI reads your shadcn theme variables (and --radius, --font-sans). For the iOS look add the bl-theme item. The "dark" variant is redefined to also match the element that carries .dark, so a ThemeScope root can restyle itself.

items.name: alfred-clone
items.title: Alfred
items.description: A macOS Alfred-style launcher on the CommandMenu primitive, floating over a desktop with a menu bar and dock. Its features are nested pages, each with its own keys: a calculator with live results and history (type math at the root and the answer shows inline), clipboard history with a preview pane, pinning (⌘P) and delete (⌘⌫), an emoji grid you move through with the arrow keys, snippets that expand from ;keywords, file search with folders you open with → and reveal with ⌘↵, system commands (lock screen, sleep, empty Trash with a confirmation, dark mode, restart), web searches, and multi-step workflows (create a GitHub issue, start a timer). ⌥Space hides and shows the bar, and a HUD confirms each copy. Adapts to its container's width; light and dark.

items.name: apple-mail
items.title: Apple Mail clone
items.description: Apple Mail: Favorites, Smart Mailboxes and iCloud sections with rolling unread counts; a message list with unread dots, flags, attachments, previews and relative times; swipe actions (ListRow), edit mode, search and an unread filter; a message view with a quoted thread and reply, flag, move, archive and trash; and a compose sheet. One SplitView at every size: three tiled columns on desktop, an overlay sidebar on iPad, a stack with large titles and back buttons on iPhone. Composed from SplitView (sections, large titles), ListRow, Icon, SearchField, SheetContent, MarkdownEditor and DropdownMenu.

items.name: apple-music
items.title: Apple Music
items.description: Apple Music: Listen Now, Browse, Radio, Search and a Library (Recently Added, Artists, Albums, Songs, playlists) with generated album artwork, album, artist and playlist pages that tint from their artwork, and a mini player that springs open into the full Now Playing screen — scrubber, transport, volume, lyrics and up next — as one morphing element. A SplitView sidebar on desktop and tablet; the iOS tab bar with the mini player above it on phones; light and dark.

items.name: apple-notes
items.title: Apple Notes clone
items.description: Apple Notes: iCloud and On My Mac folders with All iCloud, Recently Deleted and tags; notes grouped Pinned · Today · Previous 7 Days… with snippets, or a gallery of thumbnails; a Markdown note editor with checklists and tables; pin, lock, share, move, delete, search, swipe actions (ListRow) and new notes that spring into place. One SplitView at every size: three tiled columns on desktop (the list steps aside for the gallery), an overlay sidebar on iPad, a stack with large titles and back buttons on iPhone. Composed from SplitView (sections, large titles, supplementaryVisible), ListRow, Icon, SearchField, MarkdownEditor (classNames), Segmented and DropdownMenu.

items.name: apple-passwords
items.title: Apple Passwords
items.description: Apple's Passwords app: category tiles with counts (All, Passkeys, Codes, Wi-Fi, Security, Deleted) and shared groups, a searchable item list, and a detail with copy buttons, a password that morphs into view, verification codes with a countdown ring, a “Copied” HUD, edit mode, security recommendations by severity, and Wi-Fi networks with a QR code. Three columns on desktop, two on tablet, a pushed stack on phones; light and dark.

items.name: apple-reminders
items.title: Apple Reminders
items.description: Apple Reminders: smart-list tiles (Today, Scheduled, All, Flagged, Completed) with live counts, colored lists with sections, circular checkboxes that spring filled, inline add, a details sheet (notes, date and time, flag, priority, subtasks), show/clear completed, search, and a small burst when a list is cleared. Sidebar and list side by side on wide screens; the lists screen pushes the list on phones. Large list titles fold into the bar as you scroll; tints with each list's color, light and dark.

items.name: apple-settings
items.title: Apple Settings
items.description: iOS, iPadOS and macOS Settings in one block: search, an Apple Account header, inset groups with colored icon tiles, and drill-down panes with switches, sliders, pickers and segmented controls. One SplitView: macOS System Settings at desktop, an iPad split on tablets, and on phones the large-title list with panes pushing over it. Display & Brightness switches light and dark live.

items.name: codex-clone
items.title: Codex clone
items.description: A chat-and-documents workspace in the style of Codex: an icon rail and chat list (New chat, Priority for chats with replies waiting), a chat with dot — link chips and cover cards for the documents it writes, streaming replies, a composer — and a document pane with an editable Markdown page, a checklist you can tick and a section outline in its margin (ticks that open a card of headings on hover). Every chat has its own workspace: picking another switches the document pane to that chat's documents, back on the section you left, and links between documents open in place. The sidebar has two forms — with the inbox (Priority, then chats), or without it (Projects as folders of threads, then Recents) — and a project thread fills the chat and document columns with a wide transcript, a turn rail whose dashes open a card with the message and its reply, and the thread's panel (Changes, Sources). Three tiled columns on desktop; chats → chat → document as a stack on a phone. Composed from SplitView, MarkdownEditor, DropdownMenu and the Workbench icon buttons.

items.name: delivery-tracking
items.title: Delivery tracking
items.description: An order card resting over a live map: a ProgressStepper walks through the delivery stages while the chat below answers questions about the order. Composed from ArtifactChatContainer, FloatingSheet and ProgressStepper.

items.name: discord-clone
items.title: Discord clone
items.description: A team chat in Discord's shape: server rail, channel sidebar with threads, a transcript with reactions and thread previews, a member list, and a thread panel that docks on wide screens and slides over on narrow ones. Composed from ChatShell and TabView, with its own channel, message, member and composer parts.

items.name: github-clone
items.title: GitHub clone
items.description: A GitHub repository page: file browser with README and code viewer, issue and pull request lists with labels, a pull request conversation with review timeline, merge box and comment composer, a unified diff for Files changed, and Actions runs. Primer colors in light and dark; collapses to a phone layout with pushed screens.

items.name: loop-qa
items.title: Loop QA
items.description: An agentic QA workspace after Loop QA / Replay QA. Projects (a URL under test) with drawn site thumbnails, bug trends and live-run state; per project an Overview (tiles, the live run, an exploration replay carousel, latest findings), a filterable Bugs table (severity, status, kind, environment; copy, download and connect an issue tracker), a Site map tree with coverage, Test runs and generated Playwright tests with highlighted source. A bug opens to its session replay (ReplayPreview: scrubber markers for the failed request and the error, a drawn cursor with click ripples), network and console logs that seek the replay, expected vs actual, a chronology whose evidence frames are the replay frozen at each step, and the root cause; a run to its findings, coverage, exploration and journeys. The Ask QA agent is an ArtifactChatContainer around the app (the page is the artifact): a trailing column on a desktop, a floating composer over the page on a tablet or phone with the transcript on its draggable bump (the newest reply peeking on a tablet), folded into a FAB when hidden; tool calls in a work log, streamed Markdown answers, and runs that report live in a card. ⌘K jumps to any project, bug or run and runs commands (start a run, copy reports, change a bug's status or severity, connect a tracker, switch the theme) across nested pages with a bug preview pane. One SplitView at every size — tiled on a desktop, a floating sidebar on a tablet, a stack on a phone; light and dark.

items.name: map-chat
items.title: Map chat
items.description: An always-floating chat over a slippy map: the guide answers with tool calls that pan, zoom, pin and route the map (walking times, distances, saved trips). Composed from ArtifactChatContainer and a small tile-map renderer with its own geo maths, places and tool-planning agent. Needs network for the map tiles.

items.name: pencilkit-sketch
items.title: PencilKit sketch pad
items.description: A freehand sketch pad: dotted paper, a PencilCanvas and the floating PencilToolbar (tools, inks, widths, undo and redo). Composed from PencilCanvas, PencilToolbar and usePencilHistory.

items.name: split-view-demos
items.title: SplitView compositions
items.description: Six compositions of SplitView in one switcher: Mail (three columns), Notes (two columns), Settings (sidebar and detail), Reminders (tinted rows, large titles), Music library (a push/pop stack inside the detail) and a Notes gallery whose list steps aside. Each is a plain composition of the public SplitView parts.

items.name: t3-clone
items.title: T3 Code clone
items.description: An IDE-style agent workspace in the style of T3 Code: thread sidebar, streaming conversation with a composer that flies from centre to dock, resizable terminal dock with tabs, a surface panel (browser, terminal, files, diff, agents) — every thread keeps its own terminals and panel surface, so picking another thread switches them too — and a ⌘K command palette with nested pages (new thread in a project, link pull requests, go to file, search contents, add a project from a local folder, Git URL or GitHub) plus a live theme editor. Docks everything on desktop, slides the panel in as a drawer on tablets, and moves to a hamburger sidebar, bottom tab bar and snap-sheet terminal on phones. Composed from the WorkbenchShell, conversation, terminal and surface primitives, with its own thread sidebar parts.
